b2-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Even If Few Come
b2-27-01.scenario: In Pusztakamarás, Sütő András's mother asks you whether the village school should stay open when only a few children go there.
b2-27-01.prompt: Tell her the school stays open, even when few children go.
cues: Say it holds even if few children go
b2-27-01.target: Az iskola nyitva marad, még akkor is, ha kevés gyerek jár oda.
b2-27-01.english: The school stays open, even if few children go there.
b2-27-01.canDo: I can formulate assertive concessive conditions using még akkor is, ha...

b2-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Even If It Had Been Harder
b2-27-02.scenario: Sütő András's mother says the hard years could have driven the villagers away, and asks what you think they would have done.
b2-27-02.prompt: Tell her the villagers would not have left, even if life had been harder.
cues: Say they would not have left the village
Say it holds even if life had been hard
b2-27-02.target: Még ha nehéz lett volna is az élet, a falusiak nem hagyták volna el a falut.
b2-27-02.english: Even if life had been hard, the villagers would not have left the village.
b2-27-02.canDo: I can form counterfactual concessive past conditionals with még ha ... volna is

b2-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Wherever We Live
b2-27-03.scenario: Sütő András asks you whether the villagers and the relatives who live in other places still belong together.
b2-27-03.prompt: Tell him it does not matter where people live, and say what links them.
cues: Say it holds wherever people live
b2-27-03.target: Függetlenül attól, hogy hol élünk, az anyanyelv összeköt minket.
b2-27-03.english: Regardless of where we live, our mother tongue links us.
b2-27-03.canDo: I can formulate independent premises using függetlenül attól, hogy...

b2-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A School for the Mother Tongue
b2-27-04.scenario: Sütő András's mother asks you why a small Hungarian school matters in a village where Hungarians live scattered among the majority.
b2-27-04.prompt: Tell her what the school gives the children and what it helps the community keep.
cues: Say what kind of schooling matters
Say what the school helps keep
b2-27-04.target: Az anyanyelvi oktatás fontos a szórványban. Az iskola segíti a nyelvmegőrzést.
b2-27-04.english: Mother-tongue education is important in the szórvány. The school helps language preservation.
b2-27-04.canDo: I can talk about living with two languages (kétnyelvűség)

b2-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Homeland Means
b2-27-05.scenario: Sütő András sits by the stove with his mother and asks you what your homeland means to you.
b2-27-05.prompt: Tell him what you feel for your homeland, and that it stays the same far away.
cues: Say what you feel for your homeland
Say it holds even if you live far away
b2-27-05.target: Mély kötődést érzek a szülőföldem iránt, még akkor is, ha messze élek.
b2-27-05.english: I feel a deep attachment to my homeland, even if I live far away.
b2-27-05.canDo: I can say what hovatartozás and kötődés mean to me

b2-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Loyal to the Language
b2-27-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the evening, Sütő András's mother asks you whether the villagers will stay loyal to their mother tongue.
b2-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell her they will, even if life is hard, and say that where they live does not matter.
cues: Say they stay loyal even if life is hard
Say where they live does not matter
b2-27-consolidation.target: A falusiak hűek maradnak az anyanyelvükhöz, még akkor is, ha nehéz az élet. Függetlenül attól, hogy hol élnek, az anyanyelv összeköti őket.
b2-27-consolidation.english: The villagers stay loyal to their mother tongue, even if life is hard. Regardless of where they live, the mother tongue links them.
b2-27-consolidation.canDo: I can use még akkor is, ha and akkor sem, ha correctly
